verdict.rationale: Dynamics 365 Sales documents Copilot accepting natural-language queries or prebuilt prompts to review open tasks, assignments, pipeline updates, forecasts and team metrics. That covers natural-language retrieval of information, but there is no evidence that natural-language commands can perform actions such as creating or updating records or advancing deals. The autonomous agents draft emails and flag leads on their own, not in response to user commands. missing for 10: documented natural-language commands that execute write or operational actions, breadth of commandable operations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
